_doc: Divergences that break an exact criterion of S3 (proj v1.11 §4.5) but were investigated and documented (docs/limitations.md §1). judge_greedy.py accepts an entry only while the divergence stays a near-tie below max_margin, so a later, larger divergence on the same prompt still fails.

exceptions.observed: token 88: target-only logprobs ' light' -1.2433 vs ' pattern' -1.2470 (margin 0.0036); the speculative runs (F16 and P3-V32k-i32 drafters, n_max 8) chose ' pattern'
exceptions.explanation: F16 CUDA kernels are not batch-invariant either: changing only -ub moves top-5 next-token logprobs by 0.037-0.063 (s3_batch_invariance.txt), an order of magnitude above this margin

exceptions.observed: smoke24, token 198 of 512: target-only logprobs '_E' -0.9549 vs '_A' -0.9560 (margin 0.0011) after 'Force from cable AE: tension T'; the speculative runs (R1: F16 drafter, R11: P3-V32k-i32, n_max 8) chose '_A' and the rest of the step-by-step answer differs
exceptions.explanation: same mechanism as coco_3: a tie far below the F16 CUDA batch-shape logprob drift of 0.037-0.063 (s3_batch_invariance.txt)
